description: This header defines classes for bit encoding and decoding within byte buffers, including methods for packing/unpacking bits and bytes, and custom formatting for debugging or display purposes.

classes.name: bit_encoder
classes.description: Class for encoding bits into a byte buffer, with methods to pack bits and bytes, and to align the buffer.

classes.name: bit_decoder
classes.description: Class for decoding bits from a byte buffer, with methods to unpack bits and bytes, and to manage buffer position.

methods.name: pack
methods.description: Packs a specified number of bits from a 64-bit value into the buffer.

methods.name: pack_bytes
methods.description: Packs a range of bytes into the buffer.

methods.name: pack_bytes
methods.description: Packs bytes from a byte_buffer_view into the buffer.

methods.name: advance_bits
methods.description: Advances the read position by a specified number of bits.

methods.name: unpack
methods.description: Unpacks bits into a variable of type T.

methods.name: unpack_bytes
methods.description: Unpacks a span of bytes from the buffer.

methods.name: unpack_aligned_bytes
methods.description: Returns a view of aligned bytes from the buffer.

methods.name: align_bytes
methods.description: Aligns the buffer to the next byte boundary.
